notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.172
notes.notes:
Hello Bam Bam Boomers!
Due to the recent hiccups with the last update, we reverted some settings so performance should be better. In short it was because of the extra memory required to have dynamic resolution (not even if it's active) and TAA that needed to be enabled. We are happy to discuss them further in our discord! 

Enjoy

notes.title: Taunts & Emotes! Patch 0.1.155
notes.notes:
Hello Boomers!
Week 2 and it goes out with a bam, below you'll see a list of all the additions/fixes and changes for the game. Keep the feedback coming in our discord, we are really in awe how involved is the community helping us with finding all the bugs but also shaping the game, become on of us!

[h2] ADDITIONS[/h2]
- Taunt animations (dpad up or 1 keyboard) 
- Emotes on taunts
- Customization options (unlockable)
- Gameplay feedback additions
- Damage score updates 
- STEAM users can RENAME ONCE from the default username, OR login to an existing obb account that has that game

[h2]CHANGELOG SUMMARY[/h2]
Fixes + General Changes:
- Rebinding fixes, you can rebind movement keys as well now (ui input ignores any rebinding)
- Stadium stage became shorter
- Dragon has some small visual upgrade
- In game menu navigation fix
- Overlaying mouse over ui elements wont highlight them but works with the mouse
- Horizontal selection less sensitive now 
- Starting ranked, leaving it before a game starts, deadlocked survival (and probably arcade)
- Egirl stage optimizations
- VFX now also freeze during hitfreeze
- VFX now also slows down with the player animation

[h2] BALANCE UPDATES[/h2]

[h3]Spartan:[/h3]
- Down smash: 
  - Added a 4 second cooldown on the slow motion effect so you can't chain it into itself and get the slow motion effect again
  - Increased min charge time to 4 frames, previously 0 frames
  - Increased hitbox size around his body so it's more likely to connect rather than dash through the opponent
  - Reduced the dash range a tiny bit
  - Now stops when hitting shield
  - Reduced shield damage multiplier to 0.75x, previously 1.125x
- Forward air: On-whiff land lag increased to 12 frames, previously 10 frames

[h3]Bulma:[/h3]
- Bat: changed bat to a brighter color to make it more visible
- Up air: 
  - Added VFX to make it more clear where the active hit is
  - Hitbox size reduced slightly to better match visuals
- Neutral air:
  - Added VFX to make it more clear where the active hit is
  - Damage reduced to 10%, previously 11%
  - Hitbox size reduced slightly
  - Launch angle adjusted for more horizontal knockback to make it more difficult to chain into itself
  - On-whiff landing lag increased to 19 frames, previously 16 frames
- Forward air: 
  - Added VFX to make it more clear where the active hit is
  - Increased hit1 damage to 13.5%, previously 11.5%
  - Increased repeated hit damage to 8%, previously 7.5%
- Down air:
  - Increased damage to 15.5%, previously 14%
  - Increased flat hitstun modifier to 16 frames, previously 14 frames
  - On-hit landing lag is reduced to 7 frames, previously 14 frames
- Neutral special:
  - Reduced range by 20%
  - Increased end lag by 2 frames
  - Increased recharge time to 3.5 seconds, previously 2.5 seconds

[h3]Huntress[/h3]
- Side special:
  - Reduced endlag by 3 frames
  - On-hit land lag reduced to 10 frames, previously 11 frames
  - On-whiff land lag reduced to 23 frames, previously 26 frames
- Down smash:  Cooldown on slowmotion effect reduced to 4 seconds, previously 8 seconds
- Forward air:
  - Increased flat hitstun modifier to 10 frames, previously 8 frames, making it just a little more reliable to combo into more attacks
  - Increased hitbox size by 6%
- Back air: On-whiff land lag reduced to 15 frames, previously 16 frames

[h3]CL[/h3]
- Jab: Added sour spot on the bottom half of the smoke so you can't scoop people up as easily while by throwing the smoke bomb on a platform above them
- Neutral air: On-whiff landing lag increased to 15 frames from 13 frames
- Up smash: Increased size of sweet spot by 8%

[h3]Fooo[/h3]
- Down tilt: Increased hitfreeze and hitstun by 1 frame on the sweetspot hit

notes.title: Bam Bam Boom Patch Notes 0.1.142
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

It’s been one full week since Bam Bam Boom launched! We’re beyond grateful for your support. We’ve been hard at work fixing the bugs you’ve reported and expanding the game with brand new content and features!

Most important update: [u][b] NOW AVAILABLE ON MAC[/b][/u]. We appreciate mac users for their patience!

[h3][b]NEW GAME MODES + LEADERBOARD[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 1v1 Ranked Matches
[*] Royale Ranked Matches
[*] Survival Mode (Local Play)
[*] SiFooo’s Challenge (Local Play)
[*] Visible Leaderboards
[/list]

[h3]CHANGELOG SUMMARY[/h3]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved menu navigation, especially for keyboard users
[*] Resolution issues after matches resolved
[*] VFX rendering fixed in multiple cases
[*] Gamepad stick settings added for customization
[*] Skin visual bugs fixed (e.g. vanishing Shaggy Degen)
[*] Better input buffering during turnaround animations
[*] Dash-dancing improved: dash cancels allowed anytime
[*] Diagonal inputs now prioritize up-specials (better for keyboard users)
[*] Smash inputs are now more lenient for diagonal directions
[*] Native wireless support for PS4/PS5 and Switch Pro Controllers—no Steam Input required
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE UPDATES[/h3]

Spartan:
[list]
[*] Down Air: Increased whiff lag (19f → 15f)
[*] Down Air: 30% less horizontal acceleration during move
[*] Down Air: Shield damage multiplier reduced (0.75x from 1.1x)
[/list]

Fooo:
[list]
[*] Down Air: Damage reduced (14% from 15%)
[*] Down Air: Hitbox size reduced by 8%
[*] Down Air: Increased heavy land lag window (35f from 29f)
[*] Down Air: Landing lag increased (29f/21f depending on window)
[/list]

Bulma:
[list]
[*] F-Smash: Reduced range, damage (15% from 16%), and knockback scaling
[*] F-Smash: Increased whiff end lag (+10f)
[*] F-Smash: Shield damage reduced (0.66x from 1x)
[*] Down Special: Hitbox slightly bigger, startup significantly faster (charge time: 11f → 18f)
[*] Down Special: Horizontal movement improved during move (0.75x from 0.6x)
[*] Neutral Air: Damage down (10% from 11%), hitbox slightly smaller
[*] Neutral Air: Launch angle adjusted for more horizontal knockback
[*] Neutral Air: Increased whiff landing lag (19f from 16f)
[/list]
